items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: The interviewee mentions Sonny Swan in a list of older musicians ('He was old like Swan, Sonny Swan and Jim Fisher') but does not describe a direct personal interaction, collaboration, or mentorship with him.

ctx.x: I'll play y'all. I'll play the salted dog first. That dog, I almost forgot how to play. I'll play y'all. I'll play y'all. I'll play y'all. I'll play y'all. I'll play y'all. I'll play y'all. I'll play y'all. I'll play y'all. I'll play y'all.
Oh, Lord. Let's see. Sonny Swan. He played it. Sure.
Way back in 19... Oh, he played it. Jesus, I guess. He played it, I guess, before I was born.
